spec.grid: the last 12 month-end decision sessions of each era; the same end is applied to both arms and both books
spec.delta: gap arm level minus unscreened level on the SAME end
spec.verdict_rule: delta_stable_levels_fragile when the delta span is <= 25% of the smaller level span in that era

eras.skipped: fewer than 3 decision ends fall inside this era

answers.reads_as: at least one (era, book) delta moves with the end grid, so the arm effect must be cited per end the way its levels are

honest: descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict on the strategy, no prereg, no trial count, no ledger booking
both arms share the panel calendar, the rank cache and the fee ladder; the arm is a universe repair, not a different strategy
the grid moves the evaluation end only, so a delta that survives it is end-stable on THIS panel and says nothing about panel arrival effects

a truncated window loses the forward leg of its own last decision, so every grid end is priced through the next decision of the same book: the published control reproduces the full-window delta exactly there, which is the proof that the cut is a cut of the evaluation end only
the churn level is a name-level mean over swapped pairs, not a portfolio return: the delta moves a reading, not money
